podcast.title: 360 Deal Speculation
podcast.body: It is speculated that The Beaches likely have a 360 deal with their label, reflecting a common modern contractual arrangement where labels partake in various income streams beyond just record sales. "Now take a ban like the beaches. I'm going to guess, I don't know for sure, but I'm going to guess that they have a 360 with their label."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Move to Kingston and Home Sale
xref.body: After the "Secret Path" shows, Gord largely stayed out of the public eye. His home in the Beaches area of Toronto was sold, and he spent most of his remaining time in Kingston. "His home in the beaches area of Toronto had been sold, and he spent most of his time in Kingston."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
